contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constantine II (AD335-337). Reverse: GLORIA EXERCITVS, Two soldiers, one standard. Obverse: Diademed and cuirassed bust right Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTI]NVS IVN NC Reverse: Two soldiers stood either side of one standard with Chi Rho. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS] Mint mark: Illegible Die axis measurement: 6.00. Dimensions: diameter: 15.76mm; weight: 1.48g
